title: Press release
description: Announce news to journalists: the fact, why it matters, approved quotes, figures the press can verify and a contact.

inputs.label: People quoted and their approval of the quote
Embargo date and time, or none

tool_actions.description: Publishing the release in the newsroom or through a wire service.

sections.title: Headline and summary
sections.prompt: The news in one sentence a journalist could reuse, then who, what, when and why it matters.

sections.title: Body
sections.prompt: Details in order of importance, with the figures and their sources.

sections.title: Quotes
sections.prompt: One or two quotes that add a view, not a repetition of the facts.

sections.title: About and key facts
sections.prompt: The company description and the facts the press can check.

sections.title: Press contact
sections.prompt: A press office or role address, or a person who agreed to be listed.

checks.verification: Every figure, name and date was checked against its source.
Each quoted person approved their quote in writing.
Legal confirmed the timing and content respect the embargo and any disclosure obligation.
